description.value: Female University of Groningen students aged 18–25, selected for a range of neuroticism scores and participating as responders in an Ultimatum Game fMRI study.

recruitment_method.value: Students from the University of Groningen were screened using the NEO Five-Factor Inventory and selected according to prespecified demographic, health, handedness, medication, and MRI-compatibility criteria.

recruitment_dates.value: Experiment sessions occurred during the first 10 days of the menstrual cycle or during the discontinuation week for oral contraceptive users.

clinical_characteristics.value: Participants had no lifetime psychiatric or neurological disorder, no relevant first-degree family history, and no medication use likely to influence test results; the sample was selected for high or low neuroticism.

description.value: Participants acted as responders in a series of 24 trials of the UG, observing fair or unfair proposals and accepting or rejecting them.

description.value: During the six-second decision window, participants rejected an unfair proposal (€9:€1, €8:€2, or €7:€3), resulting in neither player receiving money.

spans.text: However, when participants rejected the proposal, both players did not receive any money.
Participants acted as responders in a series of 24 trials of the UG
Participants were instructed to press the left button on the button box to accept the proposal and the second button on the left to reject the proposal.

instructions.value: Participants were told they would play an Ultimatum Game against an opponent offering splits of €10. They were instructed to accept or reject each proposal by pressing the corresponding button; acceptance divided the money according to the offer, whereas rejection meant neither player received money.

spans.text: Participants were told that they would be paid a percentage (10 %) of the money they had earned during the game, in addition to a fixed amount for their participation in the experiment.

stimuli.value: Fixation crosses; six-second movie clips of the same female opponent moving a mouse to propose a division; fair proposals of €5:€5 and unfair proposals of €9:€1, €8:€2, or €7:€3; response prompts; and outcome screens showing the amount earned.
